import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp/t')
from harness import *

R = {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]}

# --- whole request scope ---------------------------------------------------
check('bad json', jrun(b'{'), R)
check('trailing json', jrun(b'{"jobs":[]} {}'), R)
check('dup key top', jrun(b'{"jobs":[],"jobs":[]}'), R)
check('dup key job', jrun(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+json.dumps(LIM).encode()+b',"events":[],"services":[]}]}'), R)
check('nan', jrun(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":NaN}],"limits":'+json.dumps(LIM).encode()+b',"events":[]}]}'), R)
check('inf literal', jrun(b'{"jobs":[],"x":Infinity}'), R)
check('float overflow', jrun(b'{"jobs":[],"x":1e400}'), R)
check('float underflow ok', jrun(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+json.dumps(LIM).encode()+b',"events":[],"z":1e-400}]}'),
      {'results':[{'events':[]}]})
check('huge int token', jrun(('{"jobs":[],"x":'+'9'*4301+'}').encode()), R)
check('4300 digit int', jrun(('{"jobs":[],"x":'+'9'*4300+'}').encode()), R)
check('bom', jrun(b'\xef\xbb\xbf{"jobs":[]}'), R)
check('bad utf8', jrun(b'{"jobs":"\xff\xfe"}'), R)
check('depth 64 job scope', jrun(('{"jobs":[['+'['*61+'0'+']'*61+']]}').encode()), R)
check('depth 65 envelope', jrun(('{"jobs":[[['+'['*61+'0'+']'*61+']]]}').encode()), R)
check('top level', jrun(b'{"jobs":[],"extra":1}'), R)
check('jobs not list', jrun(b'{"jobs":{}}'), R)
check('5 jobs', jrun({'jobs':[job(svc(('A',1)),[])]*5}), R)
check('empty jobs ok', jrun({'jobs':[]}), {'results':[]})
check('trailing ws ok', jrun(b'{"jobs":[]}   \n\t'), {'results':[]})
check('nonfinite in job', jrun(b'{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+json.dumps(LIM).encode()+b',"events":[],"q":[1.5e600]}]}'), R)

# --- job scope -------------------------------------------------------------
I = {'results':[{'error':'invalid'}]}
def j(x): return {'results':[x]}
bad_jobs = [
  job([], []),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[] ) if False else None,
  job(svc(('A',0)),[]),
  job(svc(('A',4294967295)),[]),
  job(svc(('A',1),('A',2)),[]),
  job(svc(('A',1),('B',1)),[]),
  job(svc(('1A',1)),[]),
  job(svc(('A'*25,1)),[]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[], limits={}),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[], limits=dict(LIM, cells=0)),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[], limits=dict(LIM, images=17)),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[], limits=dict(LIM, files=8193)),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[], limits=dict(LIM, extra=1)),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'nope'}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':1}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'','x':1}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':0,'policy':''}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':True,'policy':''}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':1.0,'policy':''}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,0],'rid':1}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'begin','unit':[-1,1,1],'rid':1}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'begin','unit':[0,0,1],'rid':1}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':0}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':4294967296}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'spawn','unit':[0,1,1],'service':'A','x':1}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'destination':'A','wire':'x'*97}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'send','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'destination':'aa'}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'recv','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':1,'connection':[1,1],'stream':1,'wire':5}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'inspect','x':1}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'commit','epoch':'1'}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'clone','parent':[0,1,1],'child':[0,2,1]}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'open','connection':[1,0]}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'unlink','file':[1,1,1]}]),
  job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'\ud800'}]),   # lone surrogate
]
for i, jb in enumerate(bad_jobs):
    if jb is None: continue
    check('job invalid %d' % i, jrun({'jobs':[jb]}), I)

# valid policy with unpaired surrogate handled: wire surrogate is replay scope
check('events not list', jrun({'jobs':[{'services':svc(('A',1)),'limits':LIM,'events':{}}]}), I)
check('events 200001', jrun({'jobs':[job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'inspect'}]*200001)]}), I)
check('bool not int', jrun({'jobs':[job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'begin','unit':[0,1,1],'rid':True}])]}), I)

# whole-request totals: invalid jobs excluded
big = [{'op':'stage','epoch':i+1,'policy':'match(A) allow;'} for i in range(20)]
check('16 stages ok', jrun({'jobs':[job(svc(('A',1)),big[:16])]}),
      {'results':[{'events':[\n{'ok':True,'epoch':i+1,'image':{'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}} for i in range(16)]]}})
check('17 stages over', jrun({'jobs':[job(svc(('A',1)),big)]}), R)
check('invalid job excluded from stage count', jrun({'jobs':[job([],big), job(svc(('A',1)),big[:16])]}),
      {'results':[{'error':'invalid'},{'events':[{'ok':True,'epoch':i+1,'image':{'accept':[False,True],'rows':[[1,4294967295],[4294967295,4294967295]]}} for i in range(16)]}]})
check('invalid job not counted atoms', jrun({'jobs':[job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A'}), job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'match(A'*20000+'; allow;'}])]}),
      None if False else {'results':[{'error':'invalid'},{'error':'invalid'}]})
check('policy bytes counted even when grammar rejected', jrun({'jobs':[job(svc(('A',1)),[{'op':'stage','epoch':1,'policy':'zzz'*2097153}])]}), R)

sys.exit(summary())
